stem: Differentiate between digital and analogue electronics. What makes digital system better than an analogue system?
modelAnswer: Analogue electronics uses continuous-time signals. Digital electronics uses discrete binary signals and logic gates. Digital systems are generally smaller, easier to design, more accurate and precise, use less power, can be programmed, and are less affected by noise.
